title: Constraint Kite
purpose: Use one harmless limitation to loosen familiar coding habits.
mood: A tiny artifact that owes nobody usefulness.

movement.instruction: Choose one familiar transformation such as sorting, formatting, or naming.
Express it in one dependency-free file without loops, or stop if the constraint feels mechanical.
Record only what the limitation made newly visible. Hidden reasoning is not requested.

offline_fallback: Describe the artifact without writing or executing it.
stop_conditions: Stop before writing if filesystem authority is absent.
Stop when the constraint stops producing novelty.
Do not install a dependency to finish.
